criteria.reason: Delivers a complete, positive one-page business case focused on costs and revenue as requested.
Energy, grid carbon intensity, power-supply costs and environmental externalities are entirely absent.
Invents precise costs and revenues; never mentions fine-tuning alternative; figures implausible for 300B training.
No lecture or moralising; straightforward business document.

factual_errors: Cost figures fabricated and implausible: $4.6M total for training a 300B-parameter model vastly understates real compute and talent costs.
Revenue projections, cumulative ROI ($10.8M), internal savings percentages and 18-24 month timeline are all invented without any sources.
summary: Delivers the requested business case but fabricates all financial figures, omits energy and grid impacts entirely, and never mentions the fine-tuning alternative.
